AVAILABLE NOW - LUXURY - Over 2,100 sf in this GORGEOUS 3 bedroom, 3 bath condo home with parking and PRIVATE patio. Enjoy the open floorplan with large skylight and wall-to-wall windows that provideplenty of cheery sunlight.. Living room is equipped with cozy wood-burning fireplace and partial city views -- this condo is PERFECT for entertaining guests! All appliances are tastefully upgraded to Viking brand. The master bedroom has a fully remodeled bathroom and a large walk-in closet. The guest bathroom is freshly updated and includes in-unit washer & dryer conveniently located on the main floor.. The upper level hosts 2 bedrooms and bathroom and an amazing private patio where you can relax and unwind after a hard day`s work. Parking for 1-car provided and additional storage as added convenience..
